title: Conditional Effect Identification in Partial Ancestral Graphs under Selection via Selection-Equalizer Lifts
banked_reason: Graded incremental at ceiling 5.4 below the field gate 7.4 after all bounded repairs; arbitrary AllFail-to-denominator-lock synthesis remains open.
gap_reasons: AllFail is explicitly given no nonidentification implication, and the graph-to-lock step remains open.

The affine compiler only converts a supplied represented family, legal trace, forest pair, and successful rank condition into a certificate; it does not show that any of these inputs exist after Branch-sCIDP fails.

The selection-equalizer lift and connected binary example establish exact locked witnesses on specially constructed graphs, not certificates for arbitrary failing input COPAGs or the fixed target under analysis.
proof_attempt_summary: The run exhaustively developed Branch-sCIDP soundness, a source-faithful no-selection reduction, a selection-equalizer lift, an informative rational witness, and a reachability-qualified affine rank compiler. The compiler is sound for a supplied represented affine family and legal role trace, but the attempted completeness argument never derived those inputs from an arbitrary all-branches-fail COPAG. The remaining graph-to-lock implication and its output-sensitive synthesis bound are the unproved research barrier.
tldr: Branch-sCIDP is a direct published-class soundness specialization and finite formula search, not a new completeness theorem. A general selection-equalizer lift now converts any two positive rational finite SCMs with the same observational law but different ordinary interventional outcome laws into selected models with the same full selected observational law, a common positive conditioning denominator, and different joint numerators and conditional effects. The connected binary table is an exact instance, while the affine rank compiler gives a second exact construction for a supplied represented family. Whether every all-branches failure yields a represented locked construction remains open.
gap: Selected conditional identification can fail at every joint-identification branch, yet ordinary selected hedges need not preserve the conditioning denominator and an isolated conditioning root makes preservation vacuous.
fill: The project supplies an if-and-only-if tangent-rank compiler, a complete connected rational witness with a same-graph nonlocking perturbation, and a sharply delimited residual-forest-to-rank question whose resolution would finish formula-or-certificate completeness.
